annotations.text:
YeeHaw FC — broadcast direction for FC 27.
Static mockups, not a clickable prototype. Ground moves from neutral #0f1115 to broadcast midnight, the single green splits into green (performance) + amber (standing), and every corner goes square with a 12° skew as the one signature motif.
Barlow Condensed carries over from the current site as the label face.

Player cards are deliberately NOT an EA Ultimate Team card — that's their branded design. This is the same job done in our own broadcast language.
Every number on the card maps to a field the EA API already returns. Player names here are samples.
